# `report.*`

1 tool in the `report` namespace.

## `report.session_results`

Render one completed session as a per-exercise result string in the free-text idiom a coach reads (`170 lb x 12` per working set, `L 30 lb x 13` / `R 30 lb x 12` for a bilateral pair, plus a `warm-up: 3 sets` count and a `missed: 1 of 3 sets below 8 reps` line when a planned rep band was attached).

Working sets only, by the same warm-up-then-top-load rule `plan.suggest_progression` uses; a guest lifter's sets, mock-adapter sets and zero-rep sets are excluded, and an exercise with no working set is omitted. Read-only and local: it queries the store and makes no network call. The session must already be ended.

**Parameters**

- `sessionId` — `string`, **required**.
